subject: API Integration Update - Security Review Needed
content:
Hi Kathy,

I wanted to update you on the API integration progress. We've completed the authentication module and it's ready for testing.

However, we've hit a blocker - the security team needs to review our OAuth implementation before we can proceed with the payment gateway integration. I've reached out to James from Security, but haven't heard back yet.

Action items:
1. I'll complete the API documentation by end of day Thursday
2. Need you to follow up with Security team for review scheduling
3. Once approved, I can start the payment gateway work (estimated 3 days)

The good news is we're still on track for the June 15 milestone if we can get the security review done by early next week.

Let me know if you need any clarification.

Thanks,
Tom
aiSummary: Tom completed authentication module and needs security review before proceeding with payment gateway. Two action items assigned: API documentation (Tom, Thu) and security review scheduling (Kathy, tomorrow). Project still on track for June 15 if review happens next week.

subject: Accessibility Audit Results
content:
Hi team,

I've completed the initial accessibility audit for the customer portal redesign. Overall looking good, but found a few issues:

1. Navigation menu keyboard shortcuts not working properly
2. Some color contrast issues on the dashboard
3. Screen reader not announcing page changes correctly

Lisa - can you prioritize the keyboard navigation fix? That's blocking our WCAG certification.

David - the contrast issues are minor but should be addressed before launch.

I'll continue testing the remaining pages this week.

Best,
Rachel
aiSummary: Accessibility audit found keyboard navigation issues blocking WCAG certification. Lisa assigned to fix navigation shortcuts. Minor contrast issues also identified.
